desc:
Welcome to Cars Vs Trains! A game that is totally not abandoned at all! Here you can basically get hit by trains from different countries around the world! You can also drive a variety of cars that are somewhat easy to drive! I hope you enjoyed! If you like this game then make sure to share it with your friends and leave a like!
